title: The Uplift Added to a Temporary Dispute Credit for a Long-Held, Rarely Disputed Card
content:
An uplift is added to the temporary credit on a card under Personal Credit Cards for cardholders whose card has been open a long time and who rarely dispute.

1. Where the card account has been open at least 48 whole months and at most 2 billing disputes have been recorded on it in the last twenty-four months, the uplift is 40.00 USD.

2. Where the card account has been open at least 48 whole months and more than 2 billing disputes have been recorded on it in the last twenty-four months, the uplift is 15.00 USD.

3. Where the card account has been open less than 48 whole months, no uplift is added.

**How the two parts combine.**

| Whole months the card account has been open | Billing disputes recorded in the last twenty-four months | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 72 | 0 | 40.00 USD |
| 48 | 2 | 40.00 USD |
| 48 | 3 | 15.00 USD |
| 47 | 0 | none |
| 12 | 9 | none |

**On the boundaries.** The age of the account is read as at least, so an account open exactly 48 whole months is a long-held account and one open 47 whole months is not. The dispute count separates at 2: a card carrying exactly 2 disputes in the last twenty-four months takes 40.00 USD, and one carrying 3 takes 15.00 USD. For an account open less than 48 whole months the dispute count is not reached at all.
